title: Union Church, Hong Kong

terrainReference.basis: Lands Department original 5 m datum on Kennedy Road immediately along the old granite retaining terrace.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap archived 2017 place of worship site
mapIdentity.scope: Combines the archived 2017 place of worship polygon, the published address and the original 2007 site photographs. The distinct named present facility verifies the persistent site identity.

note: The original Hong Kong 5 m elevation grid determines the Kennedy Road retaining grade. The old sanctuary and freestanding tower are proportioned from the 2007 reference and the official architectural description.
